title: Industry Taxonomy
description: Schema for trend module industry configuration

slug.description: Machine identifier — lowercase, underscore-separated, no spaces or hyphens

description.description: One-line description of what this industry covers

sub_categories.description: Sub-category queries to track via pytrends. 10-15 is the sweet spot; more = more API load.

trend_threshold_pct.description: Minimum week-over-week interest change to qualify as a trend event. Null disables trend tracking for this industry.

prospect_cap_per_quarter.description: Maximum trend emails per prospect per quarter. 0 disables emails for this industry.

seasonal_active_months.description: Months (1-12) when trend events can fire. Empty array = year-round.

primary_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where pytrends should be queried for this industry.

enabled.description: Master switch for this industry. Disabled industries skip all processing.
